channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about George Gervin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about George Gervin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on George Gervin
item.description:
Pistons legend Isiah Thomas told The Athletic.

“That’s how much control he had over the basketball. “Nobody was better than George Gervin. Nobody.”

Isiah Thomas on George Gervin, Dec 16, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin
item.description:
Drexler also offered up suggestions on a handful of other NBA greats.

“And then you've got guys like Dr. J [Julius Erving], Larry Bird, George Gervin, Elgin Baylor, Oscar Robertson, Jerry West. All those guys are in the conversation,and so for people to bring this up today, to me it's just unbelievable. And I love Michael and LeBron. But still, let's not take something away from those other guys who played.”

Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin, May 29, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on David Robinson, George Gervin
item.description:
The art, created by San Antonio graffiti artist Nik Soupe, was so surprising DeRozan thought it had been doctored.

“I start seeing it go up everywhere, and it just tripped me out because I hadn't been to San Antonio yet and they put me on a wall that got David Robinson, Tim [Duncan], the Iceman [George Gervin],”

DeMar DeRozan on David Robinson, George Gervin, Nov 12, 2018. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Tony Parker on David Robinson, Sean Elliott, George Gervin
item.description:
Asked if more teams should try to rebuild around an aging core, as the Spurs did compared to the Celtics, Parker said Sunday:

“I can’t talk for other teams, but the Spurs have always been very loyal to their guys. You see George Gervin, David Robinson, Sean Elliott.”

Tony Parker on David Robinson, Sean Elliott, George Gervin, Dec 1, 2014. Source: San Antonio Express-News.
